ruledOut: Removing the anchor-repair mode, its dry-run/apply behavior or the archived un-nesting exception: phase 011 requires them.
Removing any of the five lane modes, refusal/idempotence checks, fixed order or grouped-detail reporting: phases 015 and 012 require them.

label: The optional per-mode selection API in runLaneModes (options.modes) and its repeated --mode CLI parser are not explicitly required by phase 015; upgrade-legacy calls the runner without a mode list, while the mode functions are separately exported. Consider removing both selection surfaces and using direct per-mode tests plus the fixed-order all-modes integration test. Estimate about 20 production lines removed. Risk is an untracked external consumer; no phase requirement forbids removal.

The lane CLI's --json output branch adds a format axis and test assertions without a phase requirement or a non-test caller found by the scoped search. Removing it saves roughly 5-8 production lines; keep the human-readable dry-run/no-write and all-modes sequence tests. Risk is an untracked script consumer; no phase requirement forbids removal.

The distinct anchor-repair, five lane-mode, active/archive and grouped-detail paths are requirement-backed and should remain: phase 011 requires marker-only archived un-nesting and no other archived anchor repair, phase 015 requires all five sequential modes and phase 012 requires grouped-detail counts. The eight prior P2 changes did not address the optional lane CLI surfaces, so they did not go far enough for this narrow slice, not necessarily for the whole build.
